_comment: Edit this file to change your automation. No coding needed. 'keywords' are matched case-insensitively anywhere in the text. Use [] for keywords to match EVERY comment/message. 'publicReplies' — one is picked at random and posted as a reply under the comment. 'dm' — sent as a private message to the commenter (private reply). Set any field to null to skip that action.

commentRules.name: price-request
publicReplies: Just sent you the details in your DMs! 📩
Check your DMs, I sent you everything! ✨
commentRules.dm: Hey! Thanks for asking about the price 😊 Here are all the details: [YOUR PRICE INFO / LINK HERE]

commentRules.name: link-request
commentRules.dm: Here's the link you asked for: [YOUR LINK HERE] — let me know if you have any questions!

dmRules.name: greeting
dmRules.reply:
Hey there! 👋 Thanks for reaching out. How can I help you today?

1️⃣ Type PRICE for pricing
2️⃣ Type INFO to learn more
3️⃣ Or just ask me anything!

dmRules.name: price
dmRules.reply: Here's our pricing: [YOUR PRICE INFO HERE]

dmRules.name: info
dmRules.reply: Here's more about what we do: [YOUR INFO HERE]

dmFallback: Thanks for your message! 🙌 A team member will get back to you soon. Meanwhile, type PRICE or INFO for quick answers.
